preregistration_caveat: Existing observations and outcomes have already been inspected. This is transparent registered reanalysis, not untouched prospective preregistration or blinding.
execution_statement: All E00-E17 entries have run_status planned. Creating this register executes none of these experiments. Current evidence summarizes earlier work only; earlier results are not completion of this plan.
dependency_semantics: dependencies is an acyclic operational ordering for completion of the specified primary deliverable, synthesized from the authority critical path and protocols. It does not prohibit bounded parallel acquisition, screening or implementation as described per entry. claim_validation_dependencies are later tests required before a stronger physical claim, not execution edges.
path_semantics: existing_input_source_paths are repository-relative files verified to exist when this register was written. Presence is not proof of scientific completion or validity. Proposed output paths are planned, were not created, and must receive fresh manifests when work runs. External URLs are identified in the authority and are not claimed acquired local assets.
